rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a material template for restoring former military-reservation land in Oahu to territorial jurisdiction. It shares the same operative machinery and closely parallel language: identification of land previously reserved for military purposes, followed by restoration to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii. C04 and C21 use nearly identical restoration formulas, but C11 is stronger because it likewise concerns an Oahu military reservation created by earlier presidential directives. The child's additional provision vacating prior reversion, reservation, and restriction terms is not found in the displayed candidates, but a candidate need not account for the entire directive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All land ... subsequently known as the Keaahala Military Reservation ... is hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following parcels of land comprising a part of the Schofield Barracks Military Reservation and the Wheeler Field Military Reservation, both located on the Island of Oahu, Territory of Hawaii, are hereby restored to the jurisdiction of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel operative language applies the same jurisdiction-restoration mechanism to land forming part of an Oahu military reservation.
